Container.Name: lorestudio
Container.Overview: LoreStudio: a self-hosted workspace for novelists. Plan, organise and understand your story (characters, places, threads, the manuscript, research and its history) with optional AI help from your own Ollama. You do the writing. All-in-one: the app and its web interface in one container, data in one folder. See https://github.com/brentonmallen1/LoreStudio for documentation.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: REQUIRED - the password for the 'admin' account, created on first start. The app refuses to start on an empty or default value.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything LoreStudio keeps: the database, uploads, snapshots and backups. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional - the Ollama server for AI features, e.g. http://[your server IP]:11434 for an Ollama container on this host. Without one, everything but the AI features works.

Config.Name: Ollama Model
Config.Description: The model to use. LoreStudio is built around Gemma 4 (pull it with 'ollama pull gemma4').

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional - signs sign-in tokens. Left empty, one is made on first start and kept in the data folder. Set your own with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Demo Story
Config.Description: Add the demo story 'The Last Lighthouse' on first start (only when there are no stories).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user that owns the data folder (Unraid: 99, nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group that owns the data folder (Unraid: 100, users).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for dates in the app and the schedule of automatic work.
